headline: Raintree Lane Farm House / Yangnar Studio
context: What distinguishes this home is not extravagance, but restraint. Resting gently within nearly two acres of land, the house was intentionally designed to sit humbly within its surroundings, embraced by mountains and rice fields rather than dominating them.
